# TopbarPlus

Official source: https://github.com/1ForeverHD/TopbarPlus
Pinned revision: 39610ec4ad0e2c790f1ef8067229c3cb00da26e6
License: MPL-2.0 (see LICENSE). Attribute.lua is unchanged.

The bundled source is generated by tools/build_topbarplus.py. It creates the same ModuleScript hierarchy and evaluates module factories with lexical script/require bindings, since downloaded source cannot populate Roblox ModuleScript.Source. Reference.addToReplicatedStorage is a no-op in the generated bundle only: an empty ModuleScript is not advertised to other engine require calls. Existing real TopbarPlusReference modules are reused when present. All upstream files in src are retained unchanged.

bgsiscript downloads bundle.lua only on first minimize, caches the library for the session in its original shared environment, and owns/destroys its icon separately. It does not recolor the game's topbar or alter other icons. The common library remains reusable after hub unload; no new common instance is created per reload.
